meta.title: Huashu Design (English catalog)
meta.description: English catalog entry and working-language directive for the pinned third-party huashu-design 3.5.0 skill (MIT, by 花叔, github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-design). The catalog lists an English description and English trigger words, and the loaded body keeps the upstream Chinese manual and adds an English directive; the entry disappears when the upstream bundle is not installed.
